summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py (all depot formats and export conventions handled) and ran it to produce /app/out/summary.json, which check_summary.py reports as matching every reference value. Caveat: the documented factors (1 lb = 0.45392 kg, 1 oz = 0.02837 kg) did not match the reference figures; the standard factors (0.45359237 and 0.028349523125) did, so the script uses those and deviates from summary-format.md on that point.
